name: [Portal] Create a new addon from the portal via the existing API Partner process
description:
### Summary

Partners who develop Shoptet addons today create a new addon in the Core admin under API Partner, where a multi-tab form collects the addon settings, stores the record and lets the partner submit it to Shoptet reviewers for approval. The Partner Portal takes over this agenda, so a partner must be able to start the same creation flow from the portal's Moje doplňky section and finish with an identical result: the same addon record, the same validations and the same approval request waiting for the reviewers. This task delivers that portal entry point and screen while the Core admin page keeps working unchanged until the portal cutover, using the shared-content extraction approach piloted on the addons overview. It does not change how Shoptet reviews addons, does not redesign the form into per-tab forms, and leaves addon statistics and OAuth or API settings to their own tasks. It depends on the portal layout shell, the addons overview screen and the extraction skill.

### Why?

The wiki scope row Doplňky / API Partner requires the portal to take over the existing addon agenda, including creating an addon through the current process. Without a creation entry point the portal's Moje doplňky section can only list addons, and partners would still have to switch back to the Core admin for the most common developer action. Keeping the existing process means Shoptet reviewers, the Addons team and the approval records are untouched, which is what makes this feasible for the April 2027 MVP.

### What?

A partner signed in to the Partner Portal opens Moje doplňky and starts Create new addon without leaving the portal. The steps, field validations, edit lock and submit-for-approval action behave exactly as in the Core admin page today, and completing them produces the same addon record and the same pending approval request for the reviewers. The newly created addon is listed in the portal addons overview immediately after saving. The Core admin flow remains available and unchanged until the portal cutover, and both entry points run off one shared implementation rather than a copy.

### Acceptance Criteria

Moje doplňky in the Partner Portal offers a Create new addon action that opens the creation screen inside the portal shell, gated behind the partnerPortal module.

Creating an addon from the portal yields the same st_api.service record and internal service counterpart as creating it from Admin → API Partner, verified by comparing the two records field by field on a dev project.

Submitting the new addon for approval from the portal creates the same service_approval_request entry and reviewers see it in their existing queue with no process change.

All field validations, error messages and the edit-lock behaviour match the Core admin page 1:1; no validation is added or dropped.

The new addon appears in the portal addons overview screen right after saving, without any manual cache refresh.

The Core admin Add addon flow keeps working unchanged; both entry points render off one shared implementation and the moved units are recorded in the cutover debt register.

Tests: make fe-test passes with Vitest coverage for the new portal page, PHPUnit covers the shared controller and handler logic, and all new PHP code passes PHPStan level 10.

### Open questions

- Wiki Q3: how does the existing API Partner agenda split into portal sections — does creation live only under Moje doplňky, and which of the remaining addon tabs (endpoints, codes, users, test installs) follow in this task versus later ones?
- Cutover: is the Core admin Add addon entry point hidden once the portal version is live, or do both stay until the whole API Partner section is retired?
- Which partner types may create addons from the portal — API partners with an approved partner project only, as today, or also consulting or affiliate partners?

- Portal shape to follow: `admin/controllers/PartnerPortal/PartnerPortalOverviewController.php` (invokable `#[Component]`, `#[RequiresActiveModule('partnerPortal')]`), React under `admin/react/src/PartnerPortal/pages/`; CODEOWNERS routes these paths to @shoptet/devrel-team.
